_doc: Contract dates found by hand in GHL (Luke, Oct 9) — GHL keeps no stage history, so these come from text threads ("signed contract", "ratified"), DocuSign notes and stage moves, read-only. `at` = when the deal went under contract (ISO, UTC). `add` says whether the dashboard's own count is missing it: "sticky" = add it to this month's live contract count (server/stickyCounts.js, once), "view" = a past month whose history is closed, so Month in Review / Rep past periods add it when showing that month; absent = already counted, this entry only gives the exact date (for the contract list and First contract of the month). All entries go into month-log.json (server/monthLog.js).
